# laravelcloud_database_cluster (Data Source)

Reads an existing Laravel Cloud database cluster by ID. Useful when a Terraform module needs to reference a shared cluster provisioned in a separate state OR via the Cloud dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads an existing Laravel Cloud database cluster by ID.
#
# Common use case: an app-scoped module needs to reference a SHARED
# cluster provisioned by a platform-team-managed root module. Use this
# data source to hydrate cluster metadata without importing.

data "laravelcloud_database_cluster" "shared_prd" {
  id = "dbc_01HAM..."
}

output "shared_prd_engine" {
  value = data.laravelcloud_database_cluster.shared_prd.engine
}

output "shared_prd_ha_enabled" {
  value = data.laravelcloud_database_cluster.shared_prd.high_availability
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cloud-assigned database cluster ID (ULID).

### Read-Only

- `backup_retention_days` (Number) Automatic backup retention window in days.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of cluster creation.
- `engine` (String) Database engine — `postgres-16`, `mysql-8`, etc.
- `high_availability` (Boolean) True when the HA replica is enabled.
- `name` (String) Human-readable cluster name.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the owning Cloud organisation.
- `region` (String) Deploy region — matches the app's region.
- `size` (String) Cloud size slug — `db.small`, `db.medium`, ...
- `status` (String) Cloud lifecycle status — `active`, `provisioning`, etc.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of last mutation.
